title: MIT AI-Planned Robotic Flow Platform Autonomously Synthesizes 15 Medicines
aiSystem: ASKCOS Neural Retrosynthesis + Robotic Modular Flow Synthesizer
whyItMatters: First closed integration of deep-learning retrosynthesis planning with a robotically reconfigurable modular flow-chemistry synthesizer, autonomously producing 15 clinically relevant small-molecule drugs.
summary: Connor Coley, Dale Thomas III, Justin Lummiss, Klavs Jensen, and colleagues at MIT demonstrated in Science (2019) a unified AI-to-hardware pipeline for small-molecule organic synthesis. Trained on millions of published chemical reactions, the ASKCOS neural retrosynthesis and reaction-condition planner proposed multi-step synthetic routes and selected catalysts, solvents, and temperatures; after brief expert chemical-recipe refinement, a six-axis robotic arm autonomously reconfigured modular continuous-flow reactors and separators to synthesize 15 medicinal compounds—including aspirin, lidocaine, diazepam, fluoxetine, and a five-step ACE inhibitor cascade.
technicalHighlights: Combined neural retrosynthesis tree search and reaction-condition recommendation (ASKCOS) with an automatically reconfigurable robotic flow-chemistry platform.
Autonomously executed multi-step continuous-flow syntheses for 15 diverse medicinal compounds with isolated yields matching literature standards.
Established the software-plus-robotics architecture connecting AI synthesis planning directly to physical organic chemistry execution.
caveats: Human chemists remained in the loop to validate solubility, precipitation risks, and finalize executable flow-recipe parameters before robotic execution.

scoreRationale.foundational: First end-to-end demonstration linking data-driven AI retrosynthesis directly to a reconfigurable robotic organic synthesis platform.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly catalyzed modern self-driving chemistry labs, ChemCrow, Coscientist, and automated pharmaceutical flow synthesis.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Science with physical wet-lab synthesis and analytical characterization of 15 drugs.
scoreRationale.velocity: Compressed multi-step route design and hardware reconfiguration from weeks of manual benchtop setup to hours.

sources.label: Science (2019): A robotic platform for flow synthesis of organic compounds informed by AI planning
